name: Special Meeting Notice & Agenda
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  Special Meeting / Study Session
  Gardena City Council Special Meeting
  Tuesday, August 30, 2022

In order to minimize the spread of the COVID 19 virus, Governor Newsom has signed
Assembly Bill 361. Please be advised that the Council Chambers are closed to the public and
that some, or all, of the Gardena City Council Members may attend this meeting
telephonically.

The Special Meeting / Study Session of the Gardena City Council Special Meeting of the City
of Gardena, California, was called to order at 6:07 PM on Tuesday, August 30, 2022, via
Zoom, Mayor Tasha Cerda presiding.

1.  ROLL CALL

  Present: Mayor Tasha Cerda; Council Member Mark E. Henderson; Council Member
  Rodney Tanaka; and Council Member Wanda Love; Mayor Pro Tem Paulette C. Francis
  was away on an excused absence; Other City Officials and Employees present City
  Manager Clint Osorio; City Attorney Carmen Vasquez; and Assistant City Attorney Lisa
  Kranitz, Community Development Director Greg Tsujiuchi; Senior Planner Amanda
  Acuna and City Clerk Mina Semenza.

2.  PUBLIC COMMENT - None

3.  COUNCIL ITEM

  3.A  RESOLUTION NO. 6602, Making the legally required findings to Re-Authorize the
  use of Teleconferencing in accordance with Assembly Bill 361 for meetings of the
  Gardena City Council and other Commissions, Committees and Boards subject to
  State open meeting laws

  RESOLUTION NO. 6602

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  GARDENA, CALIFORNIA, MAKING THE LEGALLY REQUIRED
  FINDINGS  TO  RE-AUTHORIZE  THE  USE  OF
  TELECONFERENCING IN ACCORDANCE WITH ASSEMBLY
  BILL 361 FOR MEETINGS OF THE GARDENA CITY COUNCIL
  AND OTHER COMMISSIONS, COMMITTEES AND BOARDS
  SUBJECT TO STATE OPEN MEETING LAWS

  City Manager Osorio presented the Staff.

  It was moved by Council Member Tanaka, seconded by Council Member
  Henderson, and carried by the following roll call vote to Adopt Resolution
  No. 6602:

  Ayes:  Council Members Tanaka, Henderson, Love, and Mayor Cerda
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Mayor Pro Tem Francis

  1
 4.  PRESENTATIONS

  4.A Proposed Development for 14600 S Western Ave

  Senior Planner Amanda Acuna, Assistant City Attorney Lisa Kranitz and
  Community Development Director Greg Tsujiuchi were present and available for
  any questions.

  Fred Shaffer, Developer of Saiko Investment Corporation gave the presentation
  and was available for any questions. Steve Ludwig, Developer Representative of
  NextGen Apartments was present and assisted with the presentation.

  No Public Speakers.

  Council Member Love and Tanaka spoke in favor of the proposed development.
  Council Member Henderson have questions regarding traffic/speeding and adding
  a lighted crosswalk. Mayor Cerda asked for confirmation of height requirements.

  4.B Proposed Development for 2315 Marine Avenue

  Senior Planner Amanda Acuna, Assistant City Attorney Lisa Kranitz and
  Community Development Director Greg Tsujiuchi were present and available for
  any questions.

  Fred Shaffer, Developer of Saiko Investment Corporation gave the presentation
  and was available for any questions.

5.  ADJOURNMENT

  At 7:37 p.m., Mayor Cerda adjourned the to the Closed Session portion of the Regular
  City Council Meeting immediately at 7:00 p.m., followed by the Regular City Council
  Meetin at 7:30 pm., on Tuesday, September 13, 2022.

  MINA SEMENZA
  City Clerk of the City of Gardena and
  Ex-officio Clerk of the Council
